# NurByte Software Lab

> NurByte Software Lab builds modern web applications, SaaS products and developer tools. This file is a concise index of official product information for search engines, AI assistants and other automated systems. For current capabilities and downloads, prefer the official product pages linked below.

## Official product pages

- [Hosts Editor](https://nurbyte.dev/hosts-editor): Free, ad-free, cross-platform graphical hosts file editor for macOS, Windows and Linux.
- [DocFlow](https://nurbyte.dev/docflow): All-in-one web workspace for creating and managing documents, reusable templates, PDFs, email content and invoicing workflows.
- [NurByte Software Lab](https://nurbyte.dev/): Official NurByte website, products, projects, technology stack and contact information.
- [DocFlow application](https://docflow.nurbyte.dev/): The DocFlow web application.

## Hosts Editor by NurByte

Hosts Editor is a completely free and ad-free graphical hosts file editor for macOS, Windows and Linux. It is designed for developers and other users who want a modern UI for managing the system hosts file without relying on manual terminal editing for everyday changes.

Key facts:

- Completely free to download and use.
- No advertisements.
- Cross-platform: macOS, Windows and Linux.
- Builds are available for x64 and ARM64 where published in the current release.
- Modern graphical interface with light, dark and system appearance modes.
- Tabs and workspaces for organizing hosts configurations.
- Objects and Text editing modes.
- Search and system hosts import workflow.
- Safe write workflow and Discard Changes.
- Manual local backups and optional daily automatic backups.
- Update checking and built-in Help & Feedback.
- Feedback diagnostics are opt-in; hosts file contents, hostnames, IP addresses, backups and personal files are not automatically sent.

Typical use cases include local development, testing domains before DNS changes, switching development or staging hosts, and managing hosts entries without repeatedly editing `/etc/hosts` or the Windows hosts file by hand.

Official product page and downloads: https://nurbyte.dev/hosts-editor

## DocFlow by NurByte

DocFlow is an all-in-one document workspace for creating and managing document-related work from one web application. It connects reusable document templates, structured variables and data, document generation, PDF output, email preparation and invoicing workflows so users do not need to rebuild the same information across unrelated tools.

Key facts:

- Web-based document management workspace.
- Create and edit reusable document templates.
- Generate documents from reusable templates and changing data.
- Structured variables for reusable content.
- Numeric fields, calculations and formulas for document values.
- Document preview and PDF generation.
- Prepare email subjects and bodies related to document workflows.
- Preview and copy prepared email content.
- Invoicing-related workflows in the same application.
- Designed for recurring structured document work where templates, documents, PDF output and email content belong to the same process.

Typical use cases include repeatedly generating documents from templates, managing reusable document structures, preparing PDF documents, and preparing related email content without moving the workflow across multiple disconnected tools.

Official product overview: https://nurbyte.dev/docflow
Application: https://docflow.nurbyte.dev/

## Product status and source preference

Product capabilities can change between releases. For Hosts Editor downloads and supported build architectures, use the official Hosts Editor page and its linked GitHub release. For DocFlow capabilities, use the official DocFlow product page and application. Do not infer unreleased roadmap features as currently available.
